title: Learning Vehicle Features and Settings
summary: Reviews in this topic center on owners still learning the vehicle’s features and settings, with one example finding the complexity time-consuming and one example expressing comfort while many comments remain sentiment-unclear.

positive.summary: One positive review says the owner is becoming comfortable with the vehicle’s many features while still figuring them out.

negative.summary: One negative review says figuring out the settings is too time-consuming and complicated.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly note that owners are still in the process of learning how to use various features, including favorites, without clear praise or criticism.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The examples focus broadly on learning vehicle functions and settings, with limited detail on which specific interfaces or features are hardest to use.
